name: Andorhal
summary: In Andorhal, the Scourge still holds the ruined town. Once northern Lordaeron's thriving agricultural heart, it became the place where Kel'Thuzad tainted the grain with the Plague of Undeath. During the Third War, that harvest carried horror across the region.

sections.title: Ground Zero of the Plague
sections.body: Before the Third War, Andorhal gathered grain from across Lordaeron and sent it east to Hearthglen and Stratholme. As the Eastweald's prosperous granary, it fed a vast network. Kel'Thuzad and the Cult of the Damned chose the town to begin their plot. They tainted crates of grain with the Plague of Undeath, turning the kingdom's breadbasket into a source of sickness. Countless citizens were infected before the Crown understood the danger.

sections.title: The Fall of the Silver Hand
sections.body:
Prince Arthas Menethil and Jaina Proudmoore first faced Kel'Thuzad in Andorhal and slew him. His death did not end the danger. After returning from Northrend as a champion of the Scourge, Arthas marched back to claim Kel'Thuzad's remains.

Uther the Lightbringer and the remaining Silver Hand paladins made a desperate stand to defend King Terenas's ashes. The paladins fell, and Arthas slew Uther, his former pupil. Now the once grand settlement is a blight-choked Scourge stronghold.

faq.q: Why is Andorhal so important to the plague's history?
faq.answer: Andorhal gathered and distributed grain across northern Lordaeron. Kel'Thuzad used its network to spread the Plague of Undeath through the harvest, sending tainted grain along the King's Road to Stratholme and nearby towns.

aliases: who is in charge of andorhal
faq.answer: The Scourge holds Andorhal's ruins. Skeletal sentries, necromancers, and ghouls patrol its scorched streets, guarding the place where their victory began in the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Did Uther the Lightbringer die here?
faq.answer: Yes. After Capital City fell, Uther and his paladins guarded the urn holding King Terenas's ashes on Andorhal's outskirts. Arthas attacked to seize it for Kel'Thuzad's remains, then dueled and slew his mentor on the road.

angles.text: As a paladin, you walk ground marked by the Silver Hand's blood. Uther the Lightbringer and his loyal knights made their final stand against Arthas here.
As one of the Forsaken, you can see Andorhal's fields as a bitter reminder of your origins. The Cult of the Damned began the fall of your mortal lives here.
